prior.evidence: The Copy lesson link contract now explicitly serializes view=lesson alongside framework, edition, control, current mode and #explorer, requires its output to parse as a valid explicit lesson state, and repeats that validity requirement in the copied-link acceptance criterion. The output therefore satisfies the explicit-view parsing rule.

The discovery-state contract now defaults an absent catalog to the lesson framework for every valid lesson address, explicitly including addresses containing q, family or level. It requires family and level validation against that resolved catalog and retains search text, deciding the previously uncovered restoration case.
